{"metadata":{"description":"DSH 空间体检：只读统计 DeepSeek Harness 的磁盘占用（数据 / 程序 / 系统缓存三区并排 + 每类 Top N 明细），清理只做可一键撤销的隔离移动，从不删除。 · Read-only disk accounting for DSH with a reversible quarantine cleanup; it never deletes.","id":"gh:1407873910","install_available":true,"language":"JavaScript","name":"dsh-disk-doctor","slug":"Yeqij/dsh-disk-doctor","topics":["cordis","deepseek-harness","disk-space","disk-usage","dsh","dsh-plugin"]},"paragraphs":[{"id":"p1s1","text":"DSH 空间体检：只读统计 DeepSeek Harness 的磁盘占用（数据 / 程序 / 系统缓存三区并排 + 每类 Top N 明细），清理只做可一键撤销的隔离移动，从不删除。 · Read-o"},{"id":"p1s2","text":"nly disk accounting for DSH with a reversible quarantine cleanup; it never deletes."},{"id":"p2s1","text":"# dsh-disk-doctor"},{"id":"p3s1","text":"**DSH 空间体检** —— 看清 DeepSeek Harness 把磁盘吃到哪去了，以及哪些部分可以收拾。"},{"id":"p4s1","text":"> DSH 从不删东西，所以这个数字只会涨。这个插件把它摊开给你看：三个区并排、每一类占多少、哪些是可再生的、哪些是你自己的会话内容。"},{"id":"p5s1","text":"**Read-only disk accounting for DeepSeek Harness: where the gigabytes went, what is regenerable, and"},{"id":"p5s2","text":" what is yours. Its one mutation is a `rename` into a quarantine folder — it never deletes, and it c"},{"id":"p5s3","text":"an be undone with one click.** English ↓"},{"id":"p6s1","text":"## 它做什么"},{"id":"p7s1","text":"- **三个区并排，永不相加。** DSH 数据文件夹 / DSH 程序安装 / 系统缓存（桌面端用户数据、pnpm 内容仓库）。三者物理字节有重叠——pnpm 仓库里放的就是插件 `node_mod"},{"id":"p7s2","text":"ules` 硬链接过去的真身——相加会把同一批字节算两遍，所以它只分开给数，并写明原因。
- **路径全部自动探测。** 数据目录跟随 `$DSH_HOME`（回落 `~/.dsh`）；程序安装目录从"},{"id":"p7s3","text":"运行中的可执行文件探测，且**必须真的存在 `resources/app.asar` 才认**，所以无头 `node` 部署会老实报"没找到"；两个系统缓存按 `%APPDATA%` / `%LOCA"},{"id":"p7s4","text":"LAPPDATA%` 探测，另有 `.config` 与 `Library/Application Support` 回落；npm 全局安装的那份 DSH 也会被单独认出来。探不到的就说探不到，不猜。"},{"id":"p7s5","text":"
- **右侧栏常驻面板。** 分类构成、每类 Top N 明细、按插件 / 按聊天记录两个视图、每行一个"在文件管理器里打开"。中文 / English 双语，跟随界面语言。
- **清理从不删除。"},{"id":"p7s6","text":"** 全包没有任何 `unlink` / `rm` / `rmdir` 调用，唯一会动你文件系统的是 `lib/cleanup.js` 里的一次 `renameSync`——移动到插件自己的隔离目录 "},{"id":"p7s7","text":"`<dshHome>/disk-doctor/quarantine/<时间戳>/`，**每移动一项就重写一次清单**，所以中途断电也留下与现实一致的记录，随时一键撤回。清理开关默认关闭，需要二次确认；"},{"id":"p7s8","text":"只处理 🟢「可以安全清理」的四类，插件本体、运行环境、程序文件和你的对话都不在其中。
- **不联网。** 清单里声明 `network: []`，并有测试钉住"两半代码都不得出现出站调用"。
- *"},{"id":"p7s9","text":"*报告脱敏。** 会离开这台机器的输出（工具结果、Markdown/JSON 报告）一律把主目录替换成 `~`；只有本机右侧栏面板显示真实路径，因为那是你要复制和打开的地方。"},{"id":"p8s1","text":"## 安装"},{"id":"p9s1","text":"要求 **DeepSeek Harness `>=0.1.0-rc.2`**（实测 `0.2.0-rc.2` 与 `0.2.1-rc.2`）、**Node.js `^22.19.0 || >=24.0"},{"id":"p9s2","text":".0`**。零运行时依赖、零构建步骤、不需要打包器。"},{"id":"p10s1","text":"[代码示例省略，未执行]"},{"id":"p11s1","text":"装完**重启 DSH**（bundle 在启动时组装）。"},{"id":"p12s1","text":"**其他方式**：直接从本仓库装 —— `dsh plugin --profile <profile> add https://github.com/Yeqij/dsh-disk-doctor`；或下"},{"id":"p12s2","text":"载本仓库，在 **插件 → 添加插件** 里粘贴文件夹的完整路径。也可以用 release 里那个与 npm 完全相同的 tgz：`dsh plugin --profile <profile> add"},{"id":"p12s3","text":" https://github.com/Yeqij/dsh-disk-doctor/releases/download/v0.1.0/dsh-disk-doctor-0.1.0.tgz`。"},{"id":"p13s1","text":"## 测试"},{"id":"p14s1","text":"[代码示例省略，未执行]"},{"id":"p15s1","text":"177 项全部通过（`locate` 18 / `scan` 55 / `plugin` 41 / `client` 63），一条命令跑完四套，不需要 DSH 宿主或已安装的 peer 包（`@dee"},{"id":"p15s2","text":"pseek-ai/dsh-tools` 与 `schemastery` 由 `test/stubs/` 的解析钩子替换）。"},{"id":"p16s1","text":"## 文档"},{"id":"p17s1","text":"| 文件 | 内容 |"},{"id":"p18s1","text":"| `README.en.md` · `README.zh.md` | 完整文档：能力声明、三个区的口径、扫描限额、JSON 契约（英 / 中） |
| `USAGE.md` | 面向普通用户：面板怎"},{"id":"p18s2","text":"么看、清理该怎么做、常见问题（中英对照） |
| `TRIAL-INSTALL.md` | 从工作副本试装、逐项验证、回退（中英对照） |
| `DESIGN.md` | 设计文档：口径、路径探测、清"},{"id":"p18s3","text":"题（中英对照） |
| `TRIAL-INSTALL.md` | 从工作副本试装、逐项验证、回退（中英对照） |
| `DESIGN.md` | 设计文档：口径、路径探测、清理模型与不变式（中文） |"},{"id":"p19s1","text":"## 仓库结构"},{"id":"p20s1","text":"仓库根目录**就是这个 npm 包**——`package.json`、`lib/`、`client/` 都在顶层，所以 `pnpm add <仓库地址>` 能直接装、`npm publish` 也能"},{"id":"p20s2","text":"是这个 npm 包**——`package.json`、`lib/`、`client/` 都在顶层，所以 `pnpm add <仓库地址>` 能直接装、`npm publish` 也能直接在根目录跑。"},{"id":"p21s1","text":"[代码示例省略，未执行]"},{"id":"p22s1","text":"## 许可证"},{"id":"p23s1","text":"MIT。"},{"id":"p24s1","text":"## English"},{"id":"p25s1","text":"**Read-only disk accounting for DeepSeek Harness**, with a cleanup that never deletes."},{"id":"p26s1","text":"- **Three areas side by side, never summed** — the DSH data folder, the DSH application install, and"},{"id":"p26s2","text":" the system caches DSH feeds (desktop user data, pnpm content store). They share physical bytes (the"},{"id":"p26s3","text":" pnpm store holds the very files the plugin `node_modules` hard-link to), so adding them would count"},{"id":"p26s4","text":" the same bytes twice. Each reports its own figure, and the report says why.
- **Every path is detec"},{"id":"p26s5","text":"ted, not guessed** — the data folder follows `$DSH_HOME`, the install folder comes from the running "},{"id":"p26s6","text":"executable and must really hold `resources/app.asar`, the caches come from `%APPDATA%` / `%LOCALAPPD"},{"id":"p26s7","text":"ATA%` with macOS/Linux fallbacks, and a second npm-global DSH install is recognised separately. When"},{"id":"p26s8","text":" something cannot be found, it says so.
- **A resident sidebar panel** — category roll-up, Top-N det"},{"id":"p26s9","text":"ail, by-plugin and by-conversation views, and an "open in file manager" control per row. Bilingual.
"},{"id":"p26s10","text":"- **The cleanup never deletes** — there is no `unlink`, `rm` or `rmdir` anywhere in the package. The"},{"id":"p26s11","text":" one filesystem mutation is a `renameSync` into the plugin's own quarantine folder, with the manifes"},{"id":"p26s12","text":"t rewritten after every single item so an interrupted run still matches the disk. Off by default, as"},{"id":"p26s13","text":"ks twice, and touches only the 🟢 "safe to clean up" categories.
- **No network access** — declared a"},{"id":"p26s14","text":"s `network: []` in the manifest, with a test that fails if either half grows an outbound call.
- **R"},{"id":"p26s15","text":"eports are redacted** — anything leaving the machine replaces your home directory with `~`. Only the"},{"id":"p26s16","text":" local panel shows real paths, because that is where you copy them from."},{"id":"p27s1","text":"**Install** — published on npm:"},{"id":"p28s1","text":"[代码示例省略，未执行]"},{"id":"p29s1","text":"[该节后续省略]"}],"truncated":true}
